## Change

Describe the observable behavior or contract changed by this pull request.

## Verification

- [ ] Tests cover the changed behavior and its boundary/error cases.
- [ ] `npm run typecheck`, `npm test`, and `npm run build` pass.
- [ ] `npm run test:coverage` passes without lowering thresholds.
- [ ] Affected Python tests and coverage pass.
- [ ] Public API, compatibility, schema, fixture, and documentation changes are called out.
- [ ] Mutation tests were run when integrity-critical logic changed.

## Release impact

- [ ] No release-note or migration entry is needed.
- [ ] Release notes and migration guidance are included.
